```{ojs}
mseMu = 1
mseSigma = 2
mseC = mseControls.c
mseN = mseControls.n

mseMean = mseC * mseMu
mseBias = mseMean - mseMu
mseVariance = mseC ** 2 * mseSigma ** 2 / mseN
mseSd = Math.sqrt(mseVariance)
mseBiasSquared = mseBias ** 2
mseValue = mseBiasSquared + mseVariance
mseOptimalC = mseMu ** 2 / (mseMu ** 2 + mseSigma ** 2 / mseN)

mseDensityDomain = {
  const low = Math.min(mseMu, mseMean - 4 * mseSd);
  const high = Math.max(mseMu, mseMean + 4 * mseSd);
  const padding = Math.max(0.08, 0.06 * (high - low));
  return [low - padding, high + padding];
}

mseDensity = d3.range(321).map(index => {
  const x = mseDensityDomain[0] + index *
    (mseDensityDomain[1] - mseDensityDomain[0]) / 320;
  const y = Math.exp(-0.5 * ((x - mseMean) / mseSd) ** 2) /
    (mseSd * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI));
  return {x, y};
})

mseDensityYMax = d3.max(mseDensity, point => point.y)

mseCurve = d3.range(151).map(index => {
  const c = 1.5 * index / 150;
  const biasSquared = ((c - 1) * mseMu) ** 2;
  const variance = c ** 2 * mseSigma ** 2 / mseN;
  return {
    c,
    biasSquared,
    variance,
    mse: biasSquared + variance
  };
})

mseCurveYMax = d3.max(mseCurve, point => point.mse)
```

```{ojs}
mseDensityPlot = Plot.plot({
  width: Math.min(520, Math.max(320, width / 2 - 18)),
  height: 330,
  marginLeft: 58,
  style: {
    background: "var(--plot-bg)",
    color: "var(--plot-fg)",
    fontFamily: bodyFont,
    fontSize: 13
  },
  x: {label: "Possible estimate μ̂ᴄ", domain: mseDensityDomain},
  y: {label: "Density", domain: [0, 1.12 * mseDensityYMax], grid: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(mseDensity, {
      x: "x",
      y: "y",
      fill: "var(--plot-fill-1)"
    }),
    Plot.line(mseDensity, {
      x: "x",
      y: "y",
      stroke: "var(--plot-series-1)",
      strokeWidth: 2.5
    }),
    Plot.ruleX([mseMu], {
      stroke: "var(--plot-reference)",
      strokeWidth: 2,
      strokeDasharray: "5,4"
    }),
    Plot.ruleX([mseMean], {
      stroke: "var(--plot-series-4)",
      strokeWidth: 2.4
    }),
    Math.abs(mseBias) > 1e-8 ? Plot.link([{
      x1: mseMean,
      x2: mseMu,
      y1: 0.12 * mseDensityYMax,
      y2: 0.12 * mseDensityYMax
    }], {
      x1: "x1",
      x2: "x2",
      y1: "y1",
      y2: "y2",
      stroke: "var(--plot-series-2)",
      strokeWidth: 4,
      markerStart: "dot",
      markerEnd: "arrow"
    }) : null,
    Math.abs(mseBias) > 1e-8 ? Plot.text([{
      x: 0.5 * (mseMean + mseMu),
      y: 0.12 * mseDensityYMax,
      label: "bias"
    }], {
      x: "x",
      y: "y",
      text: "label",
      dy: -10,
      fill: "var(--plot-series-2)",
      fontSize: 12,
      fontWeight: 600
    }) : null,
    Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "var(--plot-reference)"})
  ].filter(mark => mark !== null)
})

mseDecompositionPlot = Plot.plot({
  width: Math.min(520, Math.max(320, width / 2 - 18)),
  height: 330,
  marginLeft: 58,
  style: {
    background: "var(--plot-bg)",
    color: "var(--plot-fg)",
    fontFamily: bodyFont,
    fontSize: 13
  },
  x: {label: "Estimator multiplier c", domain: [0, 1.5], grid: true},
  y: {label: "Squared error contribution", domain: [0, 1.08 * mseCurveYMax], grid: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(mseCurve, {
      x: "c",
      y1: 0,
      y2: "variance",
      fill: "var(--plot-fill-3)"
    }),
    Plot.areaY(mseCurve, {
      x: "c",
      y1: "variance",
      y2: "mse",
      fill: "var(--plot-fill-2)"
    }),
    Plot.line(mseCurve, {
      x: "c",
      y: "variance",
      stroke: "var(--plot-series-3)",
      strokeWidth: 1.8
    }),
    Plot.line(mseCurve, {
      x: "c",
      y: "mse",
      stroke: "var(--plot-series-4)",
      strokeWidth: 2.8
    }),
    Plot.ruleX([mseOptimalC], {
      stroke: "var(--plot-series-1)",
      strokeWidth: 2,
      strokeDasharray: "5,4"
    }),
    Plot.ruleX([mseC], {
      stroke: "var(--plot-reference)",
      strokeWidth: 1.8
    }),
    Plot.dot([{c: mseC, value: mseValue}], {
      x: "c",
      y: "value",
      r: 6,
      fill: "var(--plot-series-4)",
      stroke: "var(--plot-on-accent)",
      strokeWidth: 1.2
    }),
    Plot.dot([{
      c: mseOptimalC,
      value: ((mseOptimalC - 1) * mseMu) ** 2 +
        mseOptimalC ** 2 * mseSigma ** 2 / mseN
    }], {
      x: "c",
      y: "value",
      r: 5.5,
      fill: "var(--plot-series-1)",
      stroke: "var(--plot-on-accent)",
      strokeWidth: 1.2
    }),
    Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "var(--plot-reference)"})
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
mseReadout = md`${tex`\operatorname{Bias}(\hat\mu_c)=${mseBias.toFixed(3)};\qquad
  \operatorname{Var}(\hat\mu_c)=${mseVariance.toFixed(3)};\qquad
  \operatorname{MSE}(\hat\mu_c)
  =${mseBiasSquared.toFixed(3)}+${mseVariance.toFixed(3)}
  =${mseValue.toFixed(3)}`}`

html`<div class="mse-figure-shell ojs-figure-shell">
  <div class="mse-plots ojs-plot-grid">
    <div class="mse-plot-panel ojs-plot-panel">
      <strong>Sampling distribution of ${tex`\hat\mu_c=c\bar X`}</strong>
      ${mseDensityPlot}
    </div>
    <div class="mse-plot-panel ojs-plot-panel">
      <strong>How squared bias and variance add to MSE</strong>
      ${mseDecompositionPlot}
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="mse-legend" aria-label="Plot legend">
    <span><i class="mse-variance"></i> Variance</span>
    <span><i class="mse-bias"></i> Squared bias added above variance</span>
    <span><i class="mse-total"></i> Total MSE</span>
    <span><i class="mse-optimum"></i> Minimum-MSE ${tex`c^*`}</span>
    <span><i class="mse-reference"></i> True value ${tex`\mu`}</span>
  </div>
  <div class="mse-readout" role="status" aria-live="polite">${mseReadout}</div>
</div>

<style>
  .mse-legend {
    display: flex;

```

```{ojs}
// Keep the controls mounted beneath the reactive figure.
viewof mseControls = {
  const estimatorForm = Inputs.form({
    c: Inputs.range([0.05, 1.5], {
      value: 1,
      step: 0.05,
      label: md`Multiplier ${tex`c`}`
    })
  }, {submit: false});

  const informationForm = Inputs.form({
    n: Inputs.range([5, 100], {
      value: 10,
      step: 5,
      label: md`Sample size ${tex`n`}`
    })
  }, {submit: false});

  const root = html`<div class="controls-wrap">
    <details class="controls-root" open>
      <summary>Estimator controls</summary>
      <div class="controls-grid">
        <div class="controls-col"><h4>Estimator</h4></div>
        <div class="controls-col"><h4>Information</h4></div>
      </div>
    </details>
  </div>`;

  const columns = root.querySelectorAll(".controls-col");
  columns[0].append(estimatorForm);
  columns[1].append(informationForm);

  Object.defineProperty(root, "value", {
    get: () => ({...estimatorForm.value, ...informationForm.value})
  });

  return root;
}
```

```{ojs}
html`<p class="mse-message"><strong>Trade-off:</strong> with ${tex`\mu=${mseMu}`} and ${tex`\sigma=${mseSigma}`}, the minimum occurs at ${tex`c^*=${mseOptimalC.toFixed(3)}`}. Shrinking below ${tex`c=1`} introduces bias, but can reduce the variance by more than the squared bias increases the error.</p>`
```
